Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Lokesh Kumar Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Madan Kumar, A.P.P.
 ================================

== == ==
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN KUMAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 12-07-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
02.

In the present case, the petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Gopalganj (Town) P.S. Case No. 276of 2023 registered on 10.04.2023 for the alleged offences under Section 409, 420 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

03. As per prosecution case, petitioner and other co- accused persons embezzled Government money of certain schemes of the Government namely "Mukhyamantri Peyajal Nischay Yojana" and "Mukhyamantri Gali-Nali Yojana".
04. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
The petitioner has no concern with the claim of the Government and is not connected in any official capacity in the matter.

Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.38712 of 2024(2)
dt.12-07-2024
Petitioner is a shopkeeper who used to supply the material for the scheme and gets payment in lieu thereof.
The allegation of embezzlement and official irregularities are against ward members and secretaries and the petitioner is neither a ward member nor a secretary.
He does not hold any post in the Panchayat.

The said Government programmes were of the year 2017-18 and Raj Kumar Prasad @ Raj Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31090790/
1 2018-19 and after five years the case has been lodged without any explanation for inordinate delay.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits from the facts and circumstances no case under Section 409 and 420 if the Indian Penal Code is made out against the petitioner.
Petitioner is having antecedent of one case in which he is on bail.
05. Learned A.P.P. for the State opposes the submission made on behalf of the learned counsel for the petitioner.

06. Having regard to the facts and circumstances and submission made on behalf of the parties and considering the completely vague nature of allegation against the petitioner and further considering the possibility of false allegation, let the petitioner above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the court concerned within a period of eight weeks from today, be released on bail,
on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Court of learned C.J.M., Gopalganj/concerned court in connection with Gopalganj (Town) Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.38712 of 2024(2) dt.12-07-2024 P.S. Case No. 276 of 2023, subject to the condition laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and other following conditions:
(i) One of the bailors will be a close relative of the petitioner.
(ii) The petitioner will remain present on each and every date fixed by the court below, if so required by the learned trial court.
(Arun Kumar Jha, J) anuradha/-
